title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: Sightsavers Ireland's Global Citizenship Education (GCE) programme works in schools, universities, with organisations of persons with disabilities (OPDs) and with the Irish Public to empower people in Ireland to understand and act on global development issues. We work directly with children in Delivering Equality of Opportunity in Schools (DEIS) and special stream primary schools and our partner school in Cameroon. At public events, we interact with members of the public showcasing our inclusive education work in Senegal through virtual reality headsets to foster awareness of solidarity with people with disabilities in low- and middle-income countries. The overall aim of the project is to ensure that the Irish population is aware and takes action to support disability inclusive development .
